description: The proof ledger of Proof-of-Done (plan task pod-16, docs/PROOF-LEDGER.md): the chain and verifyChain, the torn-tail repair, appends in turn, masking, the check receipt and its schema, the toolchain probe and recordCheck (lib/proof/ledger.mjs), and the command and output hashes of ShellRunner, run_command, tasks_run/tasks_status, test_run and build_run, judged by tests/verify-proof-ledger.mjs.

mutations.name: PL-no-hash-check
mutations.what: a line whose bytes are not what its hash was made of is accepted

patches.old: if (hash !== suffix[1]) return bad('hash_mismatch', 'the line is not the text its hash was made of');

mutations.name: PL-no-prev-check
mutations.what: prev is not compared with the hash of the line before

patches.old: if (entry.prev !== prev) return bad('prev_mismatch', 'prev is not the hash of the line before');

mutations.name: PL-no-seq-check
mutations.what: seq is not compared with the line number

patches.old: if (entry.seq !== expectedSeq) return bad('seq_mismatch', `seq ${JSON.stringify(entry.seq)} where ${expectedSeq} was expected`);

mutations.name: PL-no-version-check
mutations.what: a line of another version is read as this one

mutations.name: PL-loose-time
mutations.what: ts may be any text

mutations.name: PL-unknown-type-as-bad-record
mutations.what: an unknown record type is not reported as such

mutations.name: PL-no-record-check
mutations.what: verifyChain does not validate the record of a line

mutations.name: PL-envelope-any-fields
mutations.what: a line with other or more fields than the envelope is accepted

mutations.name: PL-lossy-utf8
mutations.what: a line that is not UTF-8 is decoded with replacement characters

patches.old: const UTF8 = new TextDecoder('utf-8', { fatal: true, ignoreBOM: true });
patches.new: const UTF8 = new TextDecoder('utf-8', { fatal: false, ignoreBOM: true });

mutations.name: PL-no-line-limit-on-read
mutations.what: an over-long line is read like any other

mutations.name: PL-torn-tail-is-a-line
mutations.what: bytes without a line end are read as a committed line

patches.new: const end = bytes.indexOf(0x0a, offset) === -1 ? bytes.length : bytes.indexOf(0x0a, offset);

mutations.name: PL-broken-at-last-good
mutations.what: brokenAt names the last good line instead of the first bad one

mutations.name: PL-torn-is-broken
mutations.what: a torn tail makes the ledger refuse appends instead of being repaired

mutations.name: PL-torn-not-recorded
mutations.what: the dropped torn bytes leave no uncertain record

patches.old: await this.#appendLine(state, 'uncertain', { reason: 'torn_tail', bytes: report.torn.bytes, sha256: report.torn.sha256 });

mutations.name: PL-torn-not-dropped
mutations.what: the next line is written after the torn bytes

mutations.name: PL-no-queue
mutations.what: appends to one file do not wait for each other

mutations.name: PL-never-reload
mutations.what: a file changed by someone else is never read again

patches.old: if (state.loaded && size === state.size && mtimeMs === state.mtimeMs) return;

mutations.name: PL-size-only-reload
mutations.what: an edit that keeps the size goes unnoticed

patches.old: if (state.loaded && size === state.size && mtimeMs === state.mtimeMs) return;

mutations.name: PL-no-mask
mutations.what: records are written without masking

mutations.name: PL-mask-without-registered
mutations.what: the registered secrets are not masked in records

mutations.name: PL-no-json-check
mutations.what: a record that is not JSON (a BigInt) is not refused as a bad record

patches.old: try { copy = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(record)); } catch (error) { throw fault('ledger_bad_record', `the record is not JSON: ${error.message}`); }

mutations.name: PL-no-size-limit
mutations.what: a line over 64 KiB is written

mutations.name: PL-no-validate-on-append
mutations.what: append does not validate the record

mutations.name: PL-command-unmasked
mutations.what: the receipt keeps the command as it ran

mutations.name: PL-preview-unmasked
mutations.what: the preview is not masked

mutations.name: PL-preview-mid-character
mutations.what: the preview is cut inside a character

mutations.name: PL-preview-flag
mutations.what: previewTruncated is always false

mutations.name: PL-capture-flag
mutations.what: truncated is always false

mutations.name: PL-command-flag
mutations.what: commandTruncated is always false

mutations.name: PL-hash-of-redacted-command
mutations.what: commandSha256 is of the masked command

mutations.name: PL-args-key-order
mutations.what: argsSha256 hashes the fields in another order than documented

patches.old: JSON.stringify({ command: String(command), cwd: String(cwd), shell: String(shell) })
patches.new: JSON.stringify({ cwd: String(cwd), command: String(command), shell: String(shell) })

mutations.name: PL-extra-fields-allowed
mutations.what: a check record may carry fields beyond the schema (output text)

patches.old: return keys.length === fields.length && fields.every((field) => Object.hasOwn(value, field));

mutations.name: PL-preview-size-unchecked
mutations.what: a check record with a preview over 2 KiB is valid

mutations.name: PL-stream-hash-unchecked
mutations.what: a stream sha256 that is not 64 hex digits is valid

patches.old: if (typeof stream.sha256 !== 'string' || !HEX64.test(stream.sha256)) return 'sha256 is 64 hex digits';

mutations.name: PL-relative-path-entry
mutations.what: a relative PATH entry may supply a toolchain program

mutations.name: PL-no-toolchain-cache
mutations.what: the toolchain is probed on every call

mutations.name: PL-probe-env-unscrubbed
mutations.what: the version probes get the Hub environment with its secrets

mutations.name: PL-device-task-id
mutations.what: a task id that names a Windows device is accepted

mutations.name: PL-loose-task-id
mutations.what: any task id up to 128 characters is accepted

mutations.name: PL-whole-snapshot
mutations.what: the receipt keeps the whole snapshot instead of the tree reference

mutations.name: PL-no-tree-before
mutations.what: recordCheck takes no snapshot before the command

mutations.name: SR-hash-nothing
mutations.what: BoundedCapture hashes no byte

mutations.name: SR-hash-once
mutations.what: BoundedCapture can report its hash only once

mutations.name: SR-stderr-hash
mutations.what: run() reports the stdout hash for stderr

mutations.name: LT-run-command-no-hashes
mutations.what: run_command reports no command or output hash

patches.old: commandSha256: commandSha256(command), outputSha256: result.outputSha256, outputBytes: result.outputBytes,

mutations.name: LT-tasks-status-stderr-hash
mutations.what: tasks_status reports the stdout hash for stderr

mutations.name: LT-tasks-run-no-hash
mutations.what: tasks_run reports no command hash

mutations.name: AC-test-run-no-hash
mutations.what: test_run reports no output hash

mutations.name: WE-build-run-wrong-command-hash
mutations.what: build_run hashes the runner name instead of the command
